missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend concentrated turmeric/curcumin products during pregnancy or breastfeeding without clinician review; clarify product formulation and dose.
safety_exclusions: Do not equate culinary turmeric amounts with concentrated extracts or enhanced-bioavailability products.
Do not claim safety based on traditional food use.
professional_escalation_conditions: Pregnancy, breastfeeding, fertility treatment, liver disease or concurrent anticoagulant/antiplatelet therapy.
Jaundice, dark urine, itching or abdominal pain during supplement use.
population_and_context: Pregnant or breastfeeding people considering concentrated turmeric/curcumin supplements; culinary use and concentrated supplement exposure must be distinguished.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule; no supplement-dose recommendation until pregnancy-specific safety and product formulation are assessed.
certainty_and_limitations: NCCIH Turmeric page discusses evidence and safety, but pregnancy-specific human safety data for concentrated products are limited; absence of evidence is not proof of safety. This justification remains draft pending source passage verification, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional review.
